metadata.description: Function-hook mods that ship beside the agent-scripts skills.

plugins.name: grok-bot-watch
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: watches a Grok Bot bot by UUID over a read-only CDP sidebar read and wakes this session when a new reply lands: after the running turn's next tool result when a turn runs, else as a prompt. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: session-recall
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: a numbered list of what a session made (URLs, artifacts, files, images, commits). Write #aN in a prompt to hand Claude the exact ref and whether it is still up; Claude looks them up with its assets tool, even after compaction. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: agent-should-know
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: sends each card of the built-in You should know mod (cc-plugin-you-should-know), with its Learn more explanation, to the main agent (its line after the running turn's next tool result, then the whole card as a prompt once that turn ends), hides the card, and logs the card with the agent's verdict in one file per session under ~/.local/state/agent-should-know/. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: quick-say
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: follow-through for the owner's repeated asks. At the end of a main-agent turn, one framed reminder for uncommitted or unpushed work this session made, or for a closing "shall I?"; else the likely next combo shows dim in the empty prompt. Digits 5-9 and 0 fill a combo into the prompt. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
